verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an online filing and registry service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only PDF-fillable forms, upload, fax or mail submission, and a web portal gated by an image CAPTCHA, with no documented natural-language or conversational interface. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
